moduleTitle: Module 3. Sensory, Motor, Autonomic and Endocrine Physiology

competencies.name: Hormone classes
competencies.can: Classify hormones as peptide, steroid, or amine and compare the three by synthesis, storage, and receptor location.

competencies.name: Hormone transport and half life
competencies.can: Explain how protein binding in plasma affects the free hormone fraction and the half life and predict which hormone class circulates bound.

competencies.name: Hormone receptors and target response
competencies.can: Explain why one hormone can produce different responses in different tissues and relate receptor number to target cell sensitivity.

competencies.name: Hormone interactions
competencies.can: Define synergism, permissiveness, and antagonism and identify each in a described hormone pair.

competencies.name: Control of hormone release
competencies.can: Classify a hormone stimulus as humoral, neural, or hormonal and trace an example of each.

competencies.name: Hypothalamic pituitary axes
competencies.can: Trace a three tier axis from hypothalamic releasing hormone through the anterior pituitary trophic hormone to the peripheral gland and place the long and short loop negative feedback.

competencies.name: Primary and secondary endocrine disorders
competencies.can: Use hormone levels at two tiers of an axis to classify a disorder as primary or secondary and as hypersecretion or hyposecretion.
